The respondent Nos.1-8 contested the suit filing written statement stating, inter alia, that the original owner Sudhanshu Kumar Acherjee being owner and in khas possession of the pond ultimately settled to Tazammel Huq Chowdhury on 12 Chaitra 1351 BS and he being in possession the record was wrongly done in favour of the Government for which Other Suit No.1379 of 1980 was filed and the notice of the suit was regularly served upon the Government and the suit was decreed and, as such, the plaintiff's objection to the said suit is not tenable. 

 9. From the above section it is clear the fishery other than the tank excavated on the land is non-retainable. Since no pleading is there in the suit and no issue to that effect was framed in the suit on any allegation that the tank in question is non-retainable khas land of the original landlord, we do not find any substance in the submission of the learned Counsel for the petitioner.
